lines: Still down here? The kettle's over there and it's nobody's job but yours.
When you go east, look at the water in Tideglass and tell me if it moves.
Everyone says I'm imagining mine. I would like to be imagining it.
You came down. Most of them get as far as the cage and stand there thinking.
Roxen Quill. Nineteen years on the west face, twelve keeping the Hall,
and I have never once done the job from a nice room at the top.
Terra, since you'll be wanting to know. Weight and patience.
Nothing I have hits especially hard. Nothing I have has to.
You received the QUARRY CREST.
Two of eight.
Hah. Good.
You didn't out-hit me. You out-waited me. That's the harder one to learn
and nobody ever believes me when I say so.
You learned the field art SHOULDER.
Heavy stones out in the world can be pushed now.
Nineteen years underground taught me exactly one thing worth passing on.
Anything moves. Most of it just wants a shoulder and a reason.
That goes for stone. It goes for a great deal that is not stone.
Roxen handed over 2 Great Potions.
One more thing, {name}, and I'd like you to actually hear this one.
The Foundation surveyed my workings in the spring. Depth soundings, they said.
Two hundred and eleven holes. I counted, because nobody else was going to.
They weren't measuring the rock. Nobody drills that for rock.
They were measuring what the rock is standing on.
Ask them about it sometime. Watch how fast they stop being friendly.
Beat her. Right. I owe four people money.
Take the man-engine up out of her office, it's quicker than the cage.
It only goes up. She had it built that way. She would.
Lamp check, please. No? Nobody ever has one.
She's straight on through, past the water. She'll have heard the cage.
She hears everything down here. It's the only quiet place left in the city.
